purpose: Verify source, object, entity, ref, dedupe, review, label, dimension, and embedding relationships before loading specialized model-card rows.
Score each model-card-derived normalized object for promotion readiness using deterministic usefulness, demand, capability-gap, cost, deployment, model-swap, privacy, license, and dedupe signals.
Convert validated row families plus promotion decisions into table-shaped CSV files and a generated psql load script for Postgres/pgvector staging-table upserts.
Preserve the boundary between generated candidates and curated primitives by routing high-impact, license-sensitive, dedupe-sensitive, or low-scoring objects to review before promotion.
